text:
david: FYI — finance + product approved two billing tweaks going live 2026-12-01: (1) Usage Credits (small prepaid bundles) and (2) Soft Rollover (limited carryover of unused monthly credits). Short summary below.

anna: Please post the exact rules so docs/console copy can be updated.

david: Rules:
- Usage Credits: customers can buy small bundles (25k/50k/100k tokens) that apply immediately and show as EXTRAS on invoices. They are refundable within 7 days if unused.
- Soft Rollover: up to 20% of unused monthly credits roll to next month, capped at 100k tokens. Rollover lasts 1 month only. No retroactive roll for grandfathered promos.

priya: How do we surface this in the Console and API? Any new headers/events?

david: Console: new UI in Billing -> "Credits & Rollovers" with a purchase CTA. API: optional header `x-usage-credits-remaining`. Events: `usage_credit_purchase` and `rollover_applied`. No breaking changes.

finance-bot: Billing preview job scheduled 2026-12-02T03:30Z for customers who bought credits in the first week.

eng-bot: Engineering notes: add fields `usage_credits_balance` and `rollover_balance` in account metadata, and emit telemetry event when rollover is consumed. We'll open infra tickets for backfill.

anna: Support playbook requests: canned copy for refunds, a one-click refund button for small purchases, and a banner when rollover is about to expire.

david: Agreed. Marketing will prepare external messaging emphasizing "flexible credits" and "less waste". Legal: please review refundable credit terms.

priya: Timeline: internal announce 2026-11-10 -> docs freeze 2026-11-20 -> public help article 2026-11-24 -> enforcement 2026-12-01.

david: Thanks — tagging owners @anna (product), @priya (engineering), @finance-bot for monitoring. We'll run a staging dry-run the week of 2026-11-27. :rocket:
